race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap
race.verdict: ENOLA GREY has been shaping up well from her reduced mark and might prove the answer to this competitive fillies' handicap. Chantelle is another who has offered plenty of promise in her recent starts and is second choice ahead of Ghisa and Queen Tamara . ENOLA GREY (IRE) CHANTELLE GHISA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Maldevious (4/1), Um Wadi (5/1), Ghisa (11/2), Chantelle (6/1), Queue Dos (8/1), Inside Story (10/1), Nanoscience (10/1), Queen Tamara (12/1), Ice Sovereigns (14/1), Merry (14/1), Enola Grey (16/1)
